caption:
Meta paused and updated sharing on Muse after researchers easily spotted public links to private business files and loan applications. 😅 Meta swapped the old web links, but this is your reminder to think twice before feeding company secrets into new AI tools.

Do you trust AI tools with work files?

Source: The Verge

#Meta #TechNews #DataPrivacy #AItools #MarketingNews

post.news: Meta restarted sharing on Muse after researchers found public links exposing user files, including a marketing companys internal revenue review.
post.take: Nothing says protected user data like strangers casually reading your internal company files over breakfast.
post.insight: Rushing out collaboration tools without locking down privacy turns basic user trust into an immediate PR risk.
